children: Viant announced it will not proceed with the previously announced underwritten offering of 8,500,000 Class A shares.
The company and a stockholder withdrew the planned underwritten offering of 8,500,000 Class A shares due to current market conditions.
The related 30-day option for underwriters to buy up to 1,275,000 additional Class A shares will not be exercised.
No final prospectus supplement will be filed and no Class A shares were or will be sold in the offering.
